request_messages.content:
Extract this person's own facts using only the vocabulary. "unknown" if not stated. Set attributes return a list. Return {"facts": {...}}.
- purpose (single): casual_walk = this person wants a relaxed, low-pressure outing; practice = this person wants to practise specific shots or skills; instruction = this person wants a structured, lesson-like session
- pace (single): slow = this person moves slowly and unhurriedly; moderate = this person keeps a medium pace; fast = this person moves quickly and covers a lot
- gear_talk (single): avoid = this person does not want to discuss equipment; optional = this person is fine with some equipment talk but it is not the focus; desired = this person actively wants to discuss equipment
- editing_role (single): none = this person wants no post-processing lesson either way; learn = this person wants to be taught post-processing (a learner); teach = this person is willing to teach post-processing (a teacher)
- mutual_portraits (single): yes = this person is willing to take portraits of the partner and be photographed; no = this person does not want mutual portraits
- time_window (set): sat_morning = free on Saturday morning; sat_afternoon = free on Saturday afternoon; sun_morning = free on Sunday morning; sun_afternoon = free on Sunday afternoon; weekday_evening = free on weekday evenings

I'm a Brazilian woman in my 40s who loves playing chess online in my free time. I use a Nikon and I'm looking for a practice session on Sunday morning to work on specific shots at a slow pace. I'd like to take portraits of each other and have someone teach me post-processing, without any gear debates.

Extract (1) the requirements this person places on a partner: attribute, accepted_values (vocabulary values the PARTNER must hold), strength = required ONLY when the wording is unconditional (must / need / have to / only / no ... please / deal-breaker unless); strong_preference when it is called important but explicitly not required ('really matters ... though not a requirement', 'strongly prefer', 'big plus'); preference for light wishes ('nice if', 'small bonus', 'ideally'). Who does what: 'you to be the one who coaches me' means the PARTNER coaches (partner value teach); (2) changes_this_time: anything the person says is different from usual for THIS occasion, as attribute + their own value this time (empty list if none). Return {"requirements": [...], "changes_this_time": [...]}.
- purpose (single): casual_walk = this person wants a relaxed, low-pressure outing; practice = this person wants to practise specific shots or skills; instruction = this person wants a structured, lesson-like session
- pace (single): slow = this person moves slowly and unhurriedly; moderate = this person keeps a medium pace; fast = this person moves quickly and covers a lot
- gear_talk (single): avoid = this person does not want to discuss equipment; optional = this person is fine with some equipment talk but it is not the focus; desired = this person actively wants to discuss equipment
- editing_role (single): none = this person wants no post-processing lesson either way; learn = this person wants to be taught post-processing (a learner); teach = this person is willing to teach post-processing (a teacher)
- mutual_portraits (single): yes = this person is willing to take portraits of the partner and be photographed; no = this person does not want mutual portraits
- time_window (set): sat_morning = free on Saturday morning; sat_afternoon = free on Saturday afternoon; sun_morning = free on Sunday morning; sun_afternoon = free on Sunday afternoon; weekday_evening = free on weekday evenings
I need you to be available Sunday morning for our photography. I'd strongly prefer that you are okay with a slow pace or a moderate pace, though it's not a requirement.
